title: 資源回收廠光學分選
titleEn: Optical sorting in materials recovery facilities
summary: 以「光譜辨識、噴嘴時序與回收品質」為主線，依序完成十個專題單元。學徒在場景中辨識設備、列出邊界、重算明示的教學算例、比較量測與模型，最後診斷故障並交付證據。每一單元保留機制、算例、驗證與失效四種學習任務。
summaryEn: Follow spectral recognition, ejector timing and recovery quality through ten technical units. Identify equipment in the scene, define boundaries, reproduce explicitly hypothetical examples, compare measurements with models, and diagnose faults before handing over evidence. Each unit contains mechanism, calculation, verification and failure tasks.
scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 物料組成與目標：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Feed composition and target: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 物料組成與目標 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Feed composition and target and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 先定義欲回收物與污染物，純度和回收率才有明確分母。
steps.instructionEn: Define target and contaminant classes before calculating purity and recovery.
steps.observation: 原創假想教學算例：target mass=feed*target fraction;1000*0.3；計算 1000*0.3 = 300 kg/h。適用限制：單一目標聚合物的假想進料。
steps.observationEn: Original hypothetical teaching example: target mass=feed*target fraction;1000*0.3; calculation 1000*0.3 = 300 kg/h. Applicability: Hypothetical feed for one target polymer.
steps.failure: 以總進料作回收率分母會混同產率。
steps.failureEn: Using total feed as recovery denominator confuses yield.
steps.check: 把進料中PET比例改變，觀察分母。
steps.checkEn: Vary feed PET fraction and track denominators.

knowledge.title: 物料組成與目標
knowledge.text: 先定義欲回收物與污染物，純度和回收率才有明確分母。
knowledge.textEn: Define target and contaminant classes before calculating purity and recovery.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 在「物料組成與目標」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 300 kg/h，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「以總進料作回收率分母會混同產率。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
knowledge.textEn: In the teaching model or spreadsheet for feed composition and target, first reproduce 300 kg/h, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Using total feed as recovery denominator confuses yield." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

steps.title: 單層送料與遮蔽：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Monolayer feeding and occlusion: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 單層送料與遮蔽 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。

steps.instruction: 相互覆蓋讓下層物料無法被辨識，均勻送料常比單純提高模型複雜度更重要。
steps.instructionEn: Overlapping items hide lower layers; uniform feeding can matter more than classifier complexity.
steps.observation: 原創假想教學算例：visible fraction=uncovered/total;850/1000；計算 850/1000 = 0.85 fraction。適用限制：可視物件數示例。
steps.observationEn: Original hypothetical teaching example: visible fraction=uncovered/total;850/1000; calculation 850/1000 = 0.85 fraction. Applicability: Illustrative visible object count.
steps.failure: 雙層物料可能讓光譜代表上件而噴嘴吹走下件。
steps.failureEn: Two layers can make spectra identify the upper object while the jet moves another.
steps.check: 固定相機設定，改變送料厚度比較漏檢。
steps.checkEn: Keep camera settings and vary bed depth to compare misses.

steps.objective: 區分 單層送料與遮蔽 的失效原因，提出能排除替代解釋的檢查。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish failure causes in Monolayer feeding and occlusion with a check that rules out an alternative explanation.
steps.instruction: 雙層物料可能讓光譜代表上件而噴嘴吹走下件。

steps.observation: 原創假想教學算例：visible fraction=uncovered/total;850/1000；計算 850/1000 = 0.85 fraction。適用限制：可視物件數示例。

knowledge.title: 單層送料與遮蔽
knowledge.text: 雙層物料可能讓光譜代表上件而噴嘴吹走下件。
knowledge.textEn: Two layers can make spectra identify the upper object while the jet moves another.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 在「單層送料與遮蔽」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.85 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「雙層物料可能讓光譜代表上件而噴嘴吹走下件。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
knowledge.textEn: In the teaching model or spreadsheet for monolayer feeding and occlusion, first reproduce 0.85 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Two layers can make spectra identify the upper object while the jet moves another." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.
